items.title: Series of well-known shop owners prosecuted, exposing truth behind 'luxury' Gucci, Hermes goods sold on shelves
items.summary: Vietstock reports a wave of criminal prosecutions across Vietnam this month for counterfeit-luxury retailers: a Phu Tho shop owner charged after 469 fake fashion items (Gucci, LV, Dior, Hermes among the brands) were seized; a Can Tho case with over 3,000 counterfeit products worth roughly VND1.9 billion; and an HCMC manufacturing operation producing 23,000+ counterfeit sandals. Goods moved through storefronts plus Zalo, TikTok, Facebook and Shopee, and one workshop employed up to 14 workers running full stamping/labeling production lines, illustrating an organized counterfeit supply chain trading on the Gucci name.

items.title: Danang police seize thousands of counterfeit Gucci, Hermes, Hublot and other branded items
items.summary: Danang authorities raided a warehouse in An Hai Ward, seizing over 3,600 fake sportswear/luxury items (Adidas, Nike, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Goyard among the brands), and separately uncovered thousands of counterfeits carrying Gucci, Hermes and Hublot marks on Tran Phu Street, with an estimated value reaching into the billions of dong. Investigators noted foreign nationals were frequently involved, using Vietnamese citizens as legal representatives to conceal the operations.

items.title: Inside Demna's Generation Gucci Campaign
items.summary: Vogue Philippines' August 2026 issue profiles Demna's first Gucci campaign, an 84-portrait lookbook (Alex Consani, Gabbriette, Elsa Hosk) built around the idea that there is no single 'Gucci wearer.' The piece details design references to the Tom Ford era and 1970s archives, updated Jackie and Dionysus bags, and new pieces like the Giglio tote and Paparazzo bag, framing the collection as reflecting a cultural language shared across generations rather than one fixed aesthetic.

items.title: Gucci names Thai actor-singer Billkin as newest brand ambassador
items.summary: WWD's exclusive on Gucci naming Thai actor-singer Billkin (Putthipong Assaratanakul) as its latest brand ambassador, making him the house's third Thai-market ambassador alongside Gulf Kanawut Traipipattanapong and Davika Hoorne. Positions the appointment as part of Gucci's continued push to build region-specific star power across Thailand and wider Southeast Asia under the new creative direction.

items.title: Indonesian investor outlet: Kering Q2 2026 improves but Gucci recovery still unconfirmed
items.summary: Indonesian investment-news outlet Pluang covers Kering's Q2 2026 results for local retail investors, noting group revenue returned to growth after twelve straight quarterly declines, driven mainly by a narrowing downturn at Gucci (organic sales down 2% vs -8% in Q1), while flagging persistent weak store traffic and declining mainland China sales. The piece rates Kering shares Neutral and stresses Q3 results are needed to confirm a genuine Gucci turnaround.

items.title: Fan account post celebrates Billkin as Gucci brand ambassador at Marina Bay Sands La Famiglia showcase
items.summary: A Thai fan-community Threads account posts photos and hashtags (#BILLKINxGucciLaFamiglia, #GucciMBS) celebrating Billkin's appearance as Gucci's Thai brand ambassador and special guest at the Gucci La Famiglia collection showcase at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore, captioned 'The Dawn of Gucciness.' Representative of grassroots fan-driven SNS enthusiasm around Gucci's Southeast Asian ambassador roster; exact post date and engagement counts not visible in page view.

items.title: TikTok creator praises Gucci Paparazzo bag as underrated versus feed hype
items.summary: A luxury/bag-focused TikTok creator posts a review of the Gucci Paparazzo large top-handle bag under #gucci #designerbag #luxurytiktok #bagtok, saying she had not seen the bag anywhere on her feed and that it looks even better in person. Grassroots product-level SNS chatter around the leather-goods launches Kering credited with Q2 improvement; exact post date not shown on page, engagement counts not visible in page view.

items.title: Expat forum thread: counterfeit designer items, including Gucci, rampant on Lazada and Shopee in the Philippines
items.summary: A discussion thread on the Philippines expat community forum flags the ease of finding obvious counterfeits of luxury brands including Gucci on mainstream marketplaces Lazada and Shopee, echoing industry-association findings (TRACIT, AAFA) that rank these platforms among the top sources of counterfeit-goods complaints in the region. Captures consumer-level frustration/awareness of the counterfeit-Gucci ecosystem in Southeast Asian e-commerce; thread date and engagement metrics not shown on page.

items.title: Billkin Putthipong's 2026 brand collaborations: Gucci, Skintific and more
items.summary: Tatler Asia profiles Thai star Billkin's expanding brand portfolio in 2026, anchored by his role as Gucci brand ambassador alongside newer partnerships such as Skintific Thailand, framing him as a regular fixture at Milan Men's Fashion Week representing Gucci's evolving creative direction to Southeast Asian audiences.
